rationale: Thresholds pin the current detection baseline of the gated core corpus (mapped synthetic examples + false-positive guard). Because the corpus is small, a single missed detection or spurious detection is visible: the gate exists to fail on regressions, not to grade absolute quality. Adversarial cases (tier 'adversarial') are reported as known gaps and never gate. Any corpus addition must re-evaluate these thresholds explicitly in the corresponding ticket.
